author: Staff Writer
title: EDITORIAL: Still time to cast an early ballot - NewsBreak
summary: Your chance to beat the crowd for the Aug. 18 primary election and vote early is almost up. If you prefer to avoid any potential crowds, you can still vote early through the weekend. In DeSoto County, vote at the Administrative Building, 201 E. Oak St., Arcadia, from 8 a.m.-5 p.m. through Saturday, Aug. 15. Centennial Park Recreational Center, 1120 Centennial Blvd., Port Charlotte; Charlotte Harbor Event and Conference Center, 75 Taylor St., Punta Gorda; Mac V. Horton West County Annex, 6868 San Casa Dr., Englewood; Mid-County Regional Library, 2050 Forrest Nelson Blvd., Port Charlotte.
